<description>
Two identical declarations of `NodeId` make it ambiguous for static tools such as IWYU which header should provide the symbol. The first commit moves the declaration into a header of its own.

The second commit fixes the `#include`s of the `net` and `node/eviction` modules, which the first commit touched, and adds the headers that other files previously received transitively from them.

A prerequisite for https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36808.
</description>

<commits>
685dbef600 refactor: Introduce `node/node_id.h` header

Two identical declarations of `NodeId` make it ambiguous for static
tools such as IWYU which header should provide the symbol. Move the
declaration into a header of its own.

`net.h` re-exports it, since `NodeId` is part of its interface.

144b4abf6a refactor: Fix `#include`s in `net` and `node/eviction` modules

The `#include`s added to other files replace ones they previously
received transitively via `net.h` and `node/eviction.h`.
</commits>
